text: You're standing in my hall with mud on your boots. Speak, then.
Halvard. Shieldbearer, S-rank, thirty years on the roads before they sat me behind a desk.
The shield on the wall is mine. The dent in it is a Kiln-Father's. I'd rather not talk about the rest.
The town brings us its troubles, Elowen writes them up, and people like you go and deal with them.
Do it well and your rank goes up. Do it badly and we hang your name in the Hall of Heroes - small, at the back.
The gates open where the old world broke. Each one's ranked, F to SSS, by what crawls out of it.
Never walk into one above your rank alone. I've buried enough heroes who thought they were the exception.
